definitions.gloss: brand new item; new product; unused goods
definitions.explanation: an item that has never been used or owned before; factory-fresh merchandise

examples.japanese: {新品|しんぴん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a brand new one.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{新品|しんぴん}⟦{同様|どうよう}→同様：01654_douyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧です。
examples.english: This product is in like-new condition.

examples.japanese: {新品|しんぴん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{中古品|ちゅうこひん}→中古品：08302_chuukohin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧。
examples.english: There's a big price difference between new and used items.

notes:
FORMS:
{新|しん} (new) + ⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ (item, goods) → new item

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {新品|しんぴん}⟦{同様|どうよう}→同様：01654_douyou⟧ (like new, as good as new)
- {新品|しんぴん}⟦{未開封|みかいふう}→未開封：10677_mikaifuu⟧ (brand new, unopened)
- {新品|しんぴん}⟦{未使用|みしよう}→未使用：21316_mishiyou⟧ (brand new, unused)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{中古品|ちゅうこひん}→中古品：08302_chuukohin⟧ (used item) - opposite
- ⟦{既製品|きせいひん}→既製品：08304_kiseihin⟧ (ready-made product) - different concept

USAGE:
Often seen in product listings and shopping contexts to indicate the condition of merchandise.
